pages.lesson:
LESSON: HADITH ON BRUSHING TEETH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on Etiquette of Eating (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub-stran
Topic 2.3: Hadith on brushing teeth

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith on brushing teeth. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: When do you brush your teeth?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene
2. practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene
   In simple words: practise until you can read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah
   In simple words: practise until you can practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith on brushing teeth using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith on brushing teeth in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith on brushing teeth to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on brushing teeth.
4. Show that you can: read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on brushing teeth using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on brushing teeth important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read the hadith: “Brushing of teeth is a means of purification of mouths and pleasing Allah.” (Narrated by Ibn Majah),
2. Discuss the importance of brushing their teeth regularly
3. Communication and collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced through discussing the importance of brushing their teeth regularly.
4. Learning to learn: the skill of working collaboratively through discussing the importance of brushing their teeth regularly in small groups.
5. Self-efficacy: as learners individually demonstrate how to brush their teeth and recite/sing song/qasida/poem on brushing teeth. 7 Values:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. When do you brush your teeth?
2. Why do you brush your teeth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected hadith on brushing teeth for the promotion of oral hygiene
2. practise brushing teeth as an act of ibadah

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
